title: Block = Sand
description: Makes it so that normal blocks have the properties of sand. Any block that loses its connection to the ground will fall
body: This mod makes it so that every block in Minecraft has the properties of sand... Any block that loses its connection to the ground will fall — break the base of a pillar and the whole thing collapses, mine out a cave ceiling and the overhang comes down, cut a tree at the trunk and watch the logs tumble. Thats bassically it, its a pretty simple mod lol
